meta.layer: Layer 2 of 3: stroke evidence. What S2 (Middlebury Institute Russian handwriting guide, page 1) shows for each written form, in our own words and data. No S2 artwork, crops or coordinates. S2 is a reference only; see evidence-source.txt.
meta.rule: A segment's direction counts as shown if S2 draws an arrow on it (ARROWED) or the curve leaves only one way to go between shown segments (FORCED). Branch points, uncertain retraces and unsettled loop orientations are OPEN. Forms where S2's structure differs from S1's are never animated.

classifications.ANIMATE-READY: every segment ARROWED or FORCED and S2 applies to S1 as it stands
classifications.PARTIAL-INFERABLE: could animate only with labelled inferred segments

structure.MATCH: S1 and S2 draw the same structure
structure.MINOR: small differences; S2 still maps onto S1
